Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Enrolled employee profile for biometric facial recognition and passcode fallback verification.

userId.description: Authenticated terminal operator UID owning this directory record.

roleTitle.description: Job title or security clearance role.

passcode.description: Unique employee passcode verified against the database during fallback.

checkInCode.description: Optional dedicated code (e.g. 147) that forces CHECK_IN verification.

checkOutCode.description: Optional dedicated code (e.g. 369) that forces CHECK_OUT verification.

faceSignature.description: Encoded facial landmark geometric ratio vector captured during enrollment.

isActive.description: Whether this employee is currently active for attendance check-in/out.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at update.

AttendanceLog.title: AttendanceLog
AttendanceLog.description: Immutable biometric or passcode-verified employee attendance event.

userId.description: Authenticated terminal operator UID owning this log.

employeeId.description: Document ID of the verified employee.

loggedTimeLabel.description: Formatted local time label when attendance was logged.

loggedDateKey.description: ISO date key (yyyy-MM-dd) for daily filtering.

/users/{userId}/employees/{employeeId}.description: Enrolled employee directory scoped to the authenticated terminal operator.

/users/{userId}/attendanceLogs/{logId}.description: Append-only attendance event logs scoped to the authenticated terminal operator.
